item.title: Tyrone thump relegated Armagh while Sligo secure promotion back to Division 3
item.description: Tyrone recorded their third win in Division 3 of the Allianz Hurling League this afternoon by seeing off already relegated Armagh on a 3-22 to 0-11 scoreline in Garvaghey.

item.title: Dublin demolish Down for third win in Division 1B
item.description: Dublin hit Down for six goals at Parnell Park this evening on their way to recording a third win in Division 1B of the Allianz Hurling League.

item.title: Tribesmen prove too strong for Cats in Salthill
item.description: Cathal Mannion and Aaron Niland starred as Galway inflicted Kilkenny with their third defeat of the Allianz Hurling League Division 1A campaign this evening.

item.title: Watch: Limerick find goal-scoring touch to inflict Cork's first league defeat
item.description: Limerick struck three well-timed goals to deal Cork their first defeat of this year's Allianz Hurling League campaign.

item.title: Rossies move top of Division 3 as Donegal suffer first defeat
item.description: Roscommon moved to the top of the Allianz Hurling League Division 3 table with a 5-18 to 2-22 win over Fermanagh in Enniskillen this afternoon.

item.title: Ladies: Carlow edge Leitrim for seventh win in Division 4
item.description: Carlow maintained their perfect run in Division 4 of the Lidl National Football League when they chalked up their seventh win of the campaign and in the process inflicted a first defeat of the season on Leitrim.

item.title: Laois brush Meath aside to secure promotion to Division 1B
item.description: Laois will be playing their league hurling in Division 1B next season after recording an empathic 0-28 to 0-11 win over Meath in Portlaoise this afternoon.

item.title: Kildare retain Division 1B status with comfortable win over Carlow
item.description: Kildare secured their Allianz Hurling League Division 1B status this afternoon by seeing off Carlow on a 3-22 to 1-19 scoreline at Cedral St Conleth's Park.

item.title: Clare hold off Wexford's late charge for sixth straight league win
item.description: Clare held off a late push from Wexford in Ennis this afternoon to win their sixth consecutive game in Division 1B of the Allianz Hurling League.
